positioning: 最適な温度を保ち、飲むべき時間をそっと知らせる、スマート保温ボトル。
persona: さりげなく温度と水分を気遣ってくれる、頼れるスマートパートナー。
do_say_example: We keep your drink at the exact warmth you love, and gently remind you when to sip.
dont_say_example: This bottle will cure your dehydration forever! — This overclaims health benefits and contradicts our humble, factual tone.
